beats.text: You're straight. And you've had a same-sex fantasy. You're far from alone!
Researchers asked over fifteen hundred adults about their fantasies. Eighty-five percent of them were straight.
Women: thirty-seven percent had fantasized about sex with a woman. Now the men.
Twenty-one percent! One in five men.
Yet only six percent of the women, and under two percent of the men, said they were gay.
So a fantasy isn't a label. It's just a fantasy.

ask: NO LABEL NEEDED. JUST SAVE IT.
sources: Joyal, Cossette & Lapierre (2015), What exactly is an unusual sexual fantasy?, Journal of Sexual Medicine 12(2), 328–340 – 1,516 adults in Quebec (799 women, 717 men); 85.1% heterosexual, 3.6% homosexual (women 6%, men 1.5%), rest bisexual; item 'I have fantasized about having homosexual (or gay) sex': women 36.9%, men 20.6% (whole sample, not straight-only).
